fields.description: Schedule — run at set times. Document Event — run each time a record is created, changed, or submitted. Document Event needs the Document Query source, and works on that one record.
fields.label: Trigger

fields.description: Pick how often this task runs. Choose Custom (or leave this empty) to write the timing yourself in the field below.
fields.label: How Often
fields.options:
Every 15 minutes
Hourly
Daily 03:00
Weekly (Mon 03:00)
Custom

fields.description: A cron expression, for example 0 3 * * * for 03:00 every day. Crema checks for due tasks every 15 minutes, so a task set to run more often than that still runs only once per check. The box above fills this in unless you pick Custom.
fields.label: Custom Schedule (cron)

fields.description: Which change to a record starts this task: when one is created, changed, or submitted.
fields.label: Event
fields.options:
After Insert
On Update
On Submit

fields.description: Where this task reads from: a web address, or records already on this site. You choose the source yourself — the AI never picks one.
fields.label: Source Type

fields.description: The only address this task ever downloads. You set it here — the AI can never point the task somewhere else.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: Which kind of record this task reads. Records are read as the Runs As user set for this use case, so anything that user cannot open is never sent to the AI.
fields.label: Record Type to Read

fields.description: Narrow down which records to read. Click the table to change them. You set these — the AI never adds a filter of its own.
fields.label: Which Records

fields.description: How many records to read at most in one run. If more records match, the task picks up where it stopped on its next run — nothing is skipped.
fields.label: Records Per Run

fields.description: Read only records that changed since the last run. Keep this on: with it off, every run sends every matching record to the AI again and you pay for all of them again.
fields.label: Only Changed Records

fields.description: Which use case this task runs as. The use case decides the AI provider, the model, the spending limit, and the account the task acts as. Set them up in Crema Settings.
fields.label: Use Case

fields.description: Say in plain English what to take from the source and what to do with it.
fields.label: Instruction

fields.description: Upsert Records — create new records, or update them if they already exist. Update Source Records — change only the records this task read; it never creates one. Report Only — write nothing, just save the answer (and email it, if you want).
fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Upsert Records
Update Source Records
Report Only

fields.description: The only kind of record this task can create or change. Crema checks every run against it, so the task can never write anywhere else.
fields.label: Record Type to Write

fields.description: Email addresses to send the report to after each successful run, separated by commas. Leave empty to only save it on this task.
fields.label: Email Report To

fields.description: How this task decided to handle the source. Crema works it out on the first run and reuses it afterwards. It is a set of instructions, never code, and it is rewritten whenever you change what this task reads, writes, or is told to do.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: An existing record with the same value in these fields is updated instead of a new one being created.
fields.label: Finds Existing Records By
What the AI Is Asked to Pull Out

fields.description: The full plan as stored. Read-only — clear it only if you want Crema to start over.
fields.label: Raw Plan (JSON)

fields.description: When this task is due to run next. Empty while the task is switched off.
fields.label: Next Run

fields.description: What the last run did: how many records it handled, or the report text if this task only reports.
fields.label: Last Result

fields.description: How many runs failed in a row. Crema switches the task off at 5. A successful run resets this to 0.
fields.label: Consecutive Failures
